name: cx-box
task: Carry the box to the exit, and whenever the box falls, pick it up again.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: 'Carry the box to the exit' is correctly encoded as hard Existence(at_exit) plus hard Response(at_exit, holding_box), the prescribed pattern for carry-to (at_exit holds only on the final step, so holding_box is owed on that step), and 'whenever the box falls, pick it up again' is the hard Response(box_fell, holding_box). All three clauses trace to task sentences, no preference cues exist so hard is right for all, and the clues confirm no redundancy and that every finishing run includes at_exit and holding_box.

texts: Reach the exit at least once.
Carry the box to the exit: whenever the agent is at the exit, the box is in its hands.
Whenever the box falls, pick it up again, so the agent is holding the box after the fall.
